mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates weaker economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 50.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS show YoY declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 60 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and strong industrial demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO > 60 and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will erode the purchasing power of fixed-income assets and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors seek inflation hedges.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 45% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 55, it signals a tight labor market and strong industrial demand that will drive wage inflation and put upward pressure on the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4% and INDPRO > 55.
